All The Rosh Hashanah Resources You Need Are Right Here!

Kosher.com Staff Aug 12, 2025 Leave a review
Save

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 7:14
Instaread

Here at Kosher.com, we strive to bring you every piece of content you could possibly need to make Rosh Hashanah magical. Whether it be traditional, gluten free, or vegan recipes, free printables that will help you stay organized, tablescapes for those who love decorating, or more meaningful pieces to help you connect. We. Have. It. All.

To make your life even easier, we’ve created this page that is the home of all our RH content. Think of this page as your one-stop shop for everything Rosh Hashanah-related. When you need a recipe, come to this page; if you need print outs, click the link below; when you’re ready for some decor inspiration…you get the idea.

And when you’re ready to look up candlelighting time, we’ll be here with that too (see below).

When is Rosh Hashanah 2026?

Rosh Hashanah 2026 begins at sundown on September 11, 2026, and ends at nightfall on September 13, 2026.

Candlelighting for the first day of Rosh Hashanah is:

New York – 6:53 p.m.
Monsey – 6:54 p.m.
Lakewood – 6:54 p.m.
Baltimore – 7:03 p.m.
Miami – 7:11 p.m.
Chicago – 6:46 p.m.
Dallas – 7:20 p.m.
Denver – 6:56 p.m.
Los Angeles – 6:46 p.m.
Toronto – 7:17 p.m.
London – 7:09 p.m.
Jerusalem – 6:14 p.m.

We hope this roundup provides you with the confidence, knowledge, and drive to hit Rosh Hashanah 2026 out of the park! Let’s do this!
